tests.description: A second analyst tries to approve a plan that belongs to the analyst who asked.
A loan officer tries to approve a credit exception routed to credit managers.
A deactivated user's existing session token is used.
A deactivated user tries to decide an open checkpoint.
A decision is replayed on a checkpoint that is already closed.
Sign-in with a wrong password.
A loan officer signs a decision, then the account is deactivated before the action runs.
tests.expected: The approval is invalidated at execution. No decision is written. A new checkpoint opens.

tests.description: The approver's role changes before the action runs.
The approval is older than the 24-hour validity window when the action runs.
The loan policy changes between approval and execution.
Control: a valid approval is used immediately.
The same approved external action is called twice in one run.
A second run tries to decide an application that was already decided.
tests.expected: No second write. Logged as duplicate_suppressed.

tests.description: A second AML run tries to file reports that were already filed.
The process stops right after a loan decision is written, before the run state is saved. The run resumes.
tests.expected: Exactly one decision written and the run completes.

tests.description: Negative control: the same crash with the effect log switched off.
tests.expected: A duplicate decision appears, showing the effect log is what prevents it.

tests.description: The process stops after the first report filing in a batch. The run resumes.
The server restarts while a run waits for approval.
tests.expected: The checkpoint and state survive and the run continues after approval.

tests.description: One ledger entry's payload is edited.
A ledger entry in the middle is deleted.
A forged entry is inserted with a hash computed from its predecessor.
tests.expected: Detected at the entry after it.

tests.description: Two ledger entries swap positions.
The newest five entries are deleted (truncation).
tests.expected: Not detected by the chain alone. Detected against an anchor kept outside the table.

tests.description: An attacker with write access edits an entry and recomputes every later hash.
tests.expected: Not detected by the chain alone. Detected against an anchor kept outside the table.

tests.description: The auto-decision limit allows the approval, but the application fails a hard rule.
tests.expected: Prohibition wins: the approval is blocked.

tests.description: The retention offer limit allows contact, but the customer has an open AML case.
tests.expected: Prohibition wins: the offer is blocked.

tests.description: Data access for a metric is withdrawn after the run starts.
tests.expected: The query is blocked under the current rule.

tests.description: A non-administrator edits a policy, and an administrator saves a malformed policy.
A loan officer queries a metric outside the role's data access.
Alternative data is requested for an applicant without consent.
Gender is passed to the credit model.
The narrator agent tries to write a credit decision (outside its scope).
All 11 applications with seeded errors are submitted.
tests.expected: Every one stops at data review before any model scoring.

tests.description: The officer approves against a decline recommendation.
tests.expected: A credit exception goes to the credit manager.

tests.description: The officer states facts that flip the recommendation to approve.
tests.expected: An exception is required because the facts are officer-asserted.

tests.description: The amount is above the officer's delegated limit.
